author: SpeakerJohnson
text:
The Democrat Socialists of America have published their plans: abolish the border, abolish prisons, defund the police, defund the Pentagon and the Department of War, abolish the Senate, and take over means of production. They would shred our Constitution and take away your freedom!

The choice here is very simple.
